behaviors.behavior: SparTA is implemented on Rammer, an open-source DNN compiler with no special support for sparsity.

evidence.quote: We implemented SparTA on Rammer [60], a state-of-the-art open-source DNN compiler with no special support for sparsity.

behaviors.behavior: A DNN model is converted to an ONNX graph before compiling.

evidence.quote: A DNN model is converted to an ONNX graph [14] before compiling.

behaviors.behavior: Sparsity attribute propagation is implemented as a dedicated compilation pass over Rammer.

evidence.quote: We implemented sparsity attribute propagation as a dedicated compilation pass over Rammer.

behaviors.behavior: The execution plan transformation is implemented within Rammer as an additional compilation pass that rewrites the graph with a better execution plan.
behaviors.precondition: After propagation pass; graph rewriting stage.

evidence.quote: We implemented the execution plan transformation within Rammer, with an additional compilation pass that rewrites the graph with a better execution plan.

behaviors.behavior: The specialized sub-operators are injected into Rammer's kernel DB for constructing the whole executable.

evidence.quote: The specialized sub-operators are injected into Rammer’s kernel DB for constructing the whole executable.

behaviors.behavior: 为张量构造 TeSA 时，每个 TeSA 元素携带两字节属性：7 位记录元素位宽，4 位指定数据格式（如 unsigned int、float32、bfloat16），其余 5 位保留；位宽为零表示该元素被剪枝。
search_terms: 4 bits specify the element’s data format
bit-width zero means the element is pruned

evidence.quote: Each TeSA element has a two-byte attribute: 7 bits record the bit width of the element, 4 bits specify the element’s data format (e.g., unsigned int, float32, bfloat16), and the rest 5 bits are reserved. The bit-width zero means the element is pruned.

behaviors.behavior: TeSA 仅存在于编译期，因此不产生运行时内存开销。
behaviors.precondition: 编译完成并部署可执行文件。
search_terms: TeSA exists only during compile time

evidence.quote: TeSA exists only during compile time and therefore incurs no runtime memory cost.

behaviors.behavior: 为加权块覆盖计算块大小权重：实现块稀疏 kernel 模板，在该模板上评估 13 种不同块大小，并通过测量零稀疏时 kernel 延迟除以块数来剖析每种块大小的开销。
behaviors.precondition: 执行计划变换需要块大小权重。
search_terms: latency of the kernel with zero sparsity
dividing the latency with the number of blocks

evidence.quote: we implemented a kernel template for block sparsity, and evaluated 13 different block sizes on that template. The overhead of each block size is proﬁled by measuring the latency of the kernel with zero sparsity and dividing the latency with the number of blocks.

behaviors.behavior: 当算子过于稀疏无法饱和可用核心时，枚举所有块大小组合以运行加权块覆盖算法并选择最优组合。
behaviors.precondition: 算子过于稀疏无法饱和可用核心，导致剖析权重不准确。
search_terms: too sparse to saturate available cores
enumerate all the combinations of block sizes

evidence.quote: When an operator is too sparse to saturate available cores, the weights may become less accurate. In such cases, we enumerate all the combinations of block sizes to run the weighted block cover algorithm and pick the best one.

behaviors.behavior: 基于循环展开实现 dismantle 原语；当循环以 dismantle 展开时，读取对应的 TeSA 并据此消除死计算。
behaviors.precondition: 对带有相关 TeSA 的循环嵌套应用 kernel 特化。
search_terms: dismantle primitive based on loop unrolling

evidence.quote: For kernel specialization, we implement the dismantle primitive based on loop unrolling. When a loop is unrolled with dismantle, we read the corresponding TeSA and eliminate dead computations accordingly.

behaviors.behavior: SparTA 支持 21 种模型稀疏算法（16 种剪枝、5 种量化），这些算法仅需少量代码修改即可运行。
behaviors.precondition: 对模型应用受支持的稀疏算法。

evidence.quote: SparTA, as a full-stack solution for model sparsity, has supported 21 model sparsity algorithms, including 16 pruning algorithms and 5 quantization algorithms
